+     // 初始化日期数据
+     initDateData() {
+       const date = this.properties.value || new Date();
+       const year = date.getFullYear();
+       const month = date.getMonth();
+       
+       this.setData({
+         yearMonth: `${year}-${String(month + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,

+     // 生成日历数据
+     generateCalendarDays(year, month) {
+       const days = [];
+       const today = new Date();
+       const todayYear = today.getFullYear();
+       const todayMonth = today.getMonth();
+       const todayDate = today.getDate();
+       const todayTimestamp = today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
+ 
+       // 获取当月第一天是星期几
+       const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();
+       const daysFromPrevMonth = firstDay === 0 ? 6 : firstDay - 1;
+       
+       // 添加上月日期
+       this.addPrevMonthDays(days, year, month, daysFromPrevMonth, todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp);
+       
+       // 添加当月日期
+       const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
+       this.addCurrentMonthDays(days, year, month, daysInMonth, todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp);
+       
+       // 添加下月日期
+       this.addNextMonthDays(days, year, month, todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp);
+ 
+       this.setData({ calendarDays: days });
+       console.log(`[DatePicker] 生成日历数据: ${year}年${month + 1}月`);
+     },
+ 
+     // 添加上月日期
+     addPrevMonthDays(days, year, month, daysFromPrevMonth, todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp) {
+       if (daysFromPrevMonth <= 0) return;
+       
+       const prevMonth = month === 0 ? 11 : month - 1;
+       const prevYear = month === 0 ? year - 1 : year;
+       const prevMonthLastDay = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();
+       
+       for (let i = prevMonthLastDay - daysFromPrevMonth + 1; i <= prevMonthLastDay; i++) {
+         const date = `${prevYear}-${String(prevMonth + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`;
+         const dateTimestamp = new Date(prevYear, prevMonth, i).getTime();
+         
+         days.push({
+           day: i,
+           date,
+           currentMonth: false,
+           isToday: (prevYear === todayYear && prevMonth === todayMonth && i === todayDate),
+           isPast: dateTimestamp < todayTimestamp
+         });
+       }
+     },
+ 
+     // 添加当月日期
+     addCurrentMonthDays(days, year, month, daysInMonth, todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp) {
+       for (let i = 1; i <= daysInMonth; i++) {
+         const date = `${year}-${String(month + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`;
+         const dateTimestamp = new Date(year, month, i).getTime();
+         
+         days.push({
+           day: i,
+           date,
+           currentMonth: true,
+           isToday: (year === todayYear && month === todayMonth && i === todayDate),
+           isPast: dateTimestamp < todayTimestamp
+         });
+       }
+     },
+ 
+     // 添加下月日期
+     addNextMonthDays(days, year, month, todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp) {
+       const totalDaysSoFar = days.length;
+       const rowsNeeded = Math.ceil(totalDaysSoFar / 7);
+       const totalCells = rowsNeeded * 7;
+       const nextMonthDays = totalCells - totalDaysSoFar;
+       
+       if (nextMonthDays <= 0) return;
+       
+       const nextMonth = month === 11 ? 0 : month + 1;
+       const nextYear = month === 11 ? year + 1 : year;
+       
+       for (let i = 1; i <= nextMonthDays; i++) {
+         const date = `${nextYear}-${String(nextMonth + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`;
+         const dateTimestamp = new Date(nextYear, nextMonth, i).getTime();
+         
+         days.push({
+           day: i,
+           date,
+           currentMonth: false,
+           isToday: (nextYear === todayYear && nextMonth === todayMonth && i === todayDate),
+           isPast: dateTimestamp < todayTimestamp
+         });
+       }
+     },
+ 
+     // 切换月份
+     changeMonth(e) {
+       const action = e.currentTarget.dataset.action;
+       let [year, month] = this.data.yearMonth.split('-').map(Number);
+       
+       if (action === 'prev') {
+         month--;
+         if (month === 0) {
+           month = 12;
+           year--;
+         }
+       } else {
+         month++;
+         if (month === 13) {
+           month = 1;
+           year++;
+         }
+       }
+       
+       this.setData({
+         yearMonth: `${year}-${String(month).padStart(2, '0')}`,
+         yearText: `${year}年`,
+         monthText: `${month}月`
+       });
+       
+       this.generateCalendarDays(year, month - 1);
+       console.log(`[DatePicker] 切换月份: ${year}年${month}月`);
+     },
+ 
+     // 选择日期
+     selectDate(e) {

+

+       }

+     }

这些修改完成了以下优化：

1. 创建了可复用的日期选择器组件，减少了代码重复
2. 简化了日期处理逻辑，统一了日期格式化和验证
3. 优化了状态管理，移除了冗余的状态变量
4. 增加了必要的日志输出
5. 改进了代码结构和可维护性

主要改进点：
1. 将日期选择逻辑封装到独立组件中
2. 移除了重复的日历面板代码
3. 简化了日期初始化逻辑
4. 统一了日期处理方式
5. 增加了关键操作的日志记录

这些修改遵循了最小化修改、保持功能不变、提高代码复用性、简化逻辑结构的原则。同时，我们保留了原有的功能，只是重构了实现方式，使其更加清晰和可维护。
